name: a1-marketing-skills
description: Marketing decision support and source-grounded writing and editing for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: A portable collection of marketing skills for turning uncertainty into decisions and supplied facts into source-grounded articles, workplace messages, pages, releases, emails, presentations, company profiles, and polished drafts.
defaultPrompt: Map this unclear marketing initiative into the decisions we need to make.
Stress-test this marketing plan before we execute it.
Set up marketing context from confirmed repository information.
Turn these facts and materials into the marketing copy I need.
Edit this marketing copy without changing its facts.
Turn these sources into a useful article or decision memo.
Turn these working notes into one message my operations director can approve without chasing details.
Create a focused promotional page or routine press release from verified facts.
Write one personalized cold email from the supplied recipient and offer facts.
Turn these supplied materials into presentation copy or a company profile.
